# OKMate

OKMate (open knowledge mate) is an open-source tool for Open Knowledge Format
(OKF) bundles. Humans and agents share the same git-owned Markdown. The CLI
binary is `okmate`.

This file is the product-site starting point for visiting agents. It is not a
bundle artifact from `okmate build`. After you install the CLI, work one
knowledge root at a time.

## What to read next

- Agents setup: /agents/ (install, skill, JSON CLI)
- Human docs: /docs/
- Install (app, Homebrew, cargo, macOS bundle from source): /docs/install/
- OKF format vs `okf` crate vs `okmate`: /docs/okf/
- Project status and limits: /project/status/
- Repository: https://github.com/koliyo/okmate

## Fetch sequence

1. Read this file, then /agents/.
2. Install `okmate` (/docs/install/ or /agents/install/).
3. Point at `.agents/skills/manage-okmate-knowledge/SKILL.md` in the repo
   (https://github.com/koliyo/okmate/blob/main/.agents/skills/manage-okmate-knowledge/SKILL.md).
   Do not fork the skill.
4. `okmate roots --format paths`
5. On one path: `check`, `inspect`, or `search` (`--profile strict` in this
   project). Author inert OKF Markdown, then `check` again.

`check`, `inspect`, `search`, and `build` are single-root. There is no MCP
server and no hosted query API.

## Open Knowledge Format

OKF is a vendor-neutral contract: knowledge lives as ordinary Markdown files
with YAML frontmatter, collections, and links. It is not a hosted wiki and not
Google Cloud Knowledge Catalog.

- Spec repository: https://github.com/GoogleCloudPlatform/open-knowledge-format
- SPEC.md: https://github.com/GoogleCloudPlatform/open-knowledge-format/blob/main/SPEC.md
- Overview: https://cloud.google.com/blog/products/data-analytics/how-the-open-knowledge-format-can-improve-data-sharing
- Portable engine in this repo: https://github.com/koliyo/okmate/blob/main/okf/README.md

`okf` is the UI-neutral Rust engine (parse, validate, graph, search,
artifacts). `okmate` is the application (CLI, Askama preview, optional macOS
window). A bundle is a directory of OKF Markdown.

## Everyday commands

```
okmate roots --format paths
okmate check knowledge --profile strict --format json
okmate inspect --profile strict catalog knowledge
okmate inspect --profile strict concept architecture/system-overview knowledge
okmate search "system overview" knowledge --profile strict
```

Place `--profile` before `catalog`, `concept`, or `graph`.
`okmate roots --format json` never includes tokens.
